faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Industrial Support
faq.help_desc: Our industrial experts are at your disposal.
faq.q1: How does the virtual exhibition work?
faq.a1: Our virtual exhibition uses an immersive 2.5D interface allowing you to navigate between different thematic halls. You can click on a stand to see machines in detail, download catalogs and chat live with exhibitors.
faq.q2: Is the site free for visitors?
faq.a2: Yes, access to the catalog and the virtual exhibition is completely free for all professionals. Registration is required to contact exhibitors or save favorites.
faq.q3: How to add my products to the catalog?
faq.a3: Once your Premium or Business subscription is activated, go to your Dashboard 'My Products' section. You can import your technical sheets and photos there.
faq.a4: We accept bank transfers, CIB/Edahabia payments, and bank checks for local companies.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.inactiveStatus: A 6-digit code from your phone is required at each sign-in, in addition to your password.
mfa.step1: Install an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis…).
mfa.step2: Scan the QR code, or enter the key below.
mfa.step3: Enter the 6-digit code shown to confirm.
mfa.recoveryWarning: Each one lets you sign in if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.
mfa.disableAdminWarning: Without two-factor authentication, access to the admin console will be blocked.
mfa.gateText: The console gives access to company data and payments: two-factor authentication is mandatory.
